summary: Fixed stale build-checklist phases on retry. Backend (lib/swamp.ts getBuildStatus): the nested build-package run's steps are now only merged into the selected create-package run's steps when the build-package run's startedAt >= the create-package run's startedAt, so a leftover build-package run from a previous attempt is excluded (falling back to just the parent's coarse steps) instead of being misattributed to the new attempt; the response's run.startedAt already came from the selected create-package run and needed no change. Frontend (components/package-request/build-section.tsx): clicking Retry now records a retryAt timestamp (Date.now()) alongside wiping data/error state; a new pure helper lib/build-run-freshness.ts#isStaleRun(runStartedAt, retryAt, clockSkewMs=5000) decides whether a run returned by build-status predates the retry (with ~5s clock-skew tolerance) and should be treated as the previous attempt. While retryAt is set and the current run is missing or stale, the UI shows 'Starting new build…' instead of the old steps/dossier, and the poll loop keeps going through that window even if the stale run's status is terminal (previously it would have stopped polling on a stale 'failed'/'succeeded' status). Once a run with startedAt >= retryAt - skew appears, it renders normally. The step-checklist/phase-evidence container is now keyed by `data.run.runId` so a new run remounts it fresh (discarding any expanded PhaseEvidenceRow state from the old run) instead of reusing state.
notes: npm test (74 tests, incl. 2 new getBuildStatus attribution tests + 6 new isStaleRun tests), npm run typecheck, npm run build, and npm run lint all pass. No component/DOM test infra exists in this repo (vitest environment is 'node', include is **/*.test.ts only, no @testing-library) so the frontend-facing logic was covered by extracting the pure staleness decision into lib/build-run-freshness.ts and unit-testing that directly, per the request; build-section.tsx itself has no existing test file to extend and I didn't add new test infra (jsdom/testing-library) since that's out of scope for this fix.
